title: 第664章 掌门要渡劫了第663章 林师叔是不要走
slug: 双穿美利坚人狱苟到玄幻发育
content_zh:
第664章：掌门要渡劫了
“据说南华秘境灵气浓度比咱们这边浓郁几十倍。”
“灵气浓郁不假，不过，里面没有丝毫的秩序，十分的危险，还能遇到元婴的妖兽”
“这么危险，林师叔应该不会去的吧”
“以我对林师叔的了解，林师叔可不是退缩的人，百分百会去”
“有这个可能。”
厉武点了点头，语气里带着几分理解和感慨，
“毕竟以林师叔的天赋，自然不可能永远留在苍玄宗这种小地方。
金丹境在这里已经是顶尖高手了，南华秘境才是林师叔真正该去的地方。
他迟早是要离开的，不过是早走和晚走的区别。”
“可这也太快了吧？”
吴剑：“林师叔不是才刚突破金丹境没多久吗？
我还是前些天听萧执事说的，说林师叔在矿脉那边大展神威，斩了一头金丹境的虎妖。”
“我也只是猜测，具体情况不敢乱说。”
吴剑赶紧摆了摆手，语气里带着几分谨慎，
“林师叔的心思岂是我们能猜透的？
行了行了，都别猜了。
不管林师叔走不走，我们眼下最主要的事就是好好修炼，
尽快把修为提上去，这样才不辜负林师叔的栽培。”
闻言，五人互相对视了一眼，都从彼此的目光中看到了熊熊燃起的斗志。

是啊，把修为提上去，这才是对林师叔最好的回报。
五个人不约而同地收紧了储物袋，在心中暗暗给自己定下了修炼目标。
就因为和林枫有那么一丁点微不足道的关系，他们便得到了这么多常人想都不敢想的修炼资源，可谓是一夜暴富。
可以说，林枫是他们这辈子最大的机遇。
这份恩情，他们只能用自己的努力和忠诚去回报。
一眨眼，五天时间便过去了。
这天清晨，苍玄宗后山的禁地中雾气缭绕，古木参天，空气中弥漫着一股肃穆而庄严的气息。
这片禁地平时是苍玄宗弟子不得踏足的，因为这里安葬着苍玄宗历代的前辈先贤，
还有许多在历次战斗中牺牲的弟子。
漫山遍野的青松翠柏之间，错落有致地立着一块块斑驳的墓碑。
何元岳盘膝坐在禁地深处的一块巨大的青石上面。
这块青石是他年轻时跟着自己的师父来禁地祭拜时第一次打坐的地方，对他而言有着特殊的意义。
他选择在这里渡劫，就是为了在祖宗先辈的注视下完成这场苍玄宗数百年未有的突破。
他深吸了一口气，感受着山间清凉的空气灌入肺腑，然后又缓缓吐出。
尽管这几天来他已经将心境调整到了前所未有的平静状态，
可事到临头，看着旁边一脸自信、嘴角还挂着轻松笑意的林枫，
他的内心还是忍不住泛起一阵阵的忐忑和不安。
毕竟他即将面对的是三九小天劫，是所有修士谈之色变的存在，一旦失败便是灰飞烟灭。
“师父，别磨蹭了，快点吧。”
林枫站在巨石旁边，双手抱胸，语气轻松似乎毫不在意。

何元岳抬头看了看天色，忽然皱起了眉头：
“现在是午时三刻，这个时辰是不是有点不太吉利？”
content_en:
Chapter 664: The leader is about to survive the tribulation
"It is said that the concentration of spiritual energy in Nanhua Secret Realm is dozens of times richer than here."
"It is true that the spiritual energy is rich, but there is no order at all inside. It is very dangerous, and you can also encounter Yuanying's monsters."
"It's so dangerous, Master Lin probably won't go there, right?"
"Based on what I know about Uncle Lin, Uncle Lin is not a person who shrinks back. He will definitely go."
"It's possible."
Li Wu nodded, with some understanding and emotion in his tone,
“After all, with Master Lin’s talent, it is naturally impossible to stay in a small place like Cangxuan Sect forever.
The Jindan Realm is already a top master here, and the Nanhua Secret Realm is where Uncle Lin should really go.
He will leave sooner or later, but it's just the difference between leaving early and leaving late. "
"But isn't this too fast?"
Wu Jian: "Didn't Uncle Lin just break through to the Golden Core Realm?
I heard what Deacon Xiao said a few days ago, saying that Uncle Lin showed great power over the mine and killed a golden elixir-level tiger monster. "
"I'm just guessing, I don't dare to say anything about the specific situation."
Wu Jian quickly waved his hand, with a bit of caution in his tone,
"How can we guess Uncle Lin's thoughts?
Okay, okay, don’t even guess.
Regardless of whether Master Lin leaves or not, the most important thing for us right now is to practice well.
Improve your cultivation as soon as possible so that you can live up to Uncle Lin's cultivation. "
Hearing this, the five people looked at each other, and they all saw the burning fighting spirit in each other's eyes.
Yes, improving your cultivation is the best reward for Master Lin.
The five people tightened their storage bags in unison and secretly set their own training goals in their hearts.
Just because they had such a trivial relationship with Lin Feng, they obtained so many cultivation resources that ordinary people could not even imagine, and they became rich overnight.
It can be said that Lin Feng is the biggest opportunity in their lives.
They can only repay this kindness with their own efforts and loyalty.
In the blink of an eye, five days passed.
In the early morning of this morning, the forbidden area in the back mountain of Cangxuan Sect was filled with mist, towering ancient trees, and a solemn and solemn atmosphere filled the air.
This forbidden area is usually not allowed for Cangxuan Sect disciples to set foot on, because Cangxuan Sect’s predecessors and sages from past dynasties are buried here.
There are also many disciples who have died in previous battles.
Among the green pines and cypresses all over the mountains and plains, there are mottled tombstones standing at random intervals.
He Yuanyue sat cross-legged on a huge blue stone deep in the forbidden area.
This bluestone was the place where he meditated for the first time when he followed his master to the forbidden area to worship when he was young. It has a special meaning to him.
He chose to survive the tribulation here just to complete this breakthrough that Cangxuan Sect had not seen in hundreds of years under the watchful eyes of his ancestors.
He took a deep breath, feeling the cool mountain air pour into his lungs, and then slowly exhaled it.
Although he has adjusted his state of mind to an unprecedented calm state in the past few days,
But when things came to an end, he looked at Lin Feng next to him who looked confident and had a relaxed smile on his face.
He still couldn't help but feel waves of anxiety and uneasiness in his heart.
After all, what he is about to face is the Three Nine Small Heavenly Tribulation, which is an existence that all monks talk about. Once it fails, it will be wiped out.
"Master, stop dawdling, hurry up."
Lin Feng stood next to the boulder, with his arms crossed and his tone relaxed as if he didn't care.
He Yuanyue looked up at the sky and suddenly frowned:
"It's three quarters past noon. Isn't this a bit unlucky?"
